visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue t-shirt sits on a light grey couch in a brightly lit modern living room, looking at a black smartphone. A woman with long dark hair, wearing a red and black long-sleeved shirt, is visible in the background leaning over the couch. (2) The man jumps up in a sudden, exaggerated motion of surprise as the woman leans closer to his shoulder; his facial expression is one of shock. (3) The man is shown mid-fall, tumbling towards a blue and white patterned rug where a small white dog is lying on its back. (4) The man is slumped on the floor against the base of the couch with his eyes closed, appearing unconscious. The woman looks directly into the camera with an expression of exaggerated horror, her hands near her face. (5) The background changes to a CGI heaven-like setting with white clouds and bright sunlight. The man stands in this environment looking confused. (6) Back in the living room, the woman leans over the man's prone body to take the smartphone from his hand. (7) A close-up shot shows the phone screen displaying an Instagram-style interface with photos of women in swimsuits and dresses. (8) The woman stares at the phone with a suspicious and angry facial expression. (9) In the CGI clouds background, the man is now happily dancing and scrolling on his phone, seemingly enjoying his 'afterlife'. (10) The woman suddenly appears behind him in the heavenly setting; he turns, sees her, and his expression shifts to extreme fear as he puts his hands together in a pleading gesture.
